grader.scenario: TV 4K HDR color banding and posterization on OLED display due to HDMI TMDS clock throttling; interim profile applied and HDMI 2.1 cable dispatched
grader.notes: Okay call featuring dead air breaches, failed verification and personalization, handled empathy in middle third, HDMI 2.1 cable dispatch, and pending physical resolution.
